narrator.who: The narrator in every game: tells him what to do and cheers him on
narrator.description: A warm, cheerful female children's television host with a gentle American accent. Bright, kind and encouraging, smiling as she speaks, clear and unhurried, like reading a picture book to a preschooler. Studio-quality audio.
narrator.sample: Oh no, Biscuit has a cold! Let's help with a check-up! Stethoscope! Listen to the heart! A strong heart! Great job, Doctor! All done! Pick a sticker! A unicorn!

puppy.description: An animated cartoon puppy character voice. Very high, bouncy and excitable, breathless with joy, giggly, playful and silly. American accent. Studio-quality audio.
puppy.sample: Hi Doctor! I'm Biscuit! Woof! Hee hee! That tickles! I'm a little nervous… Ouch! That wasn't so bad! I feel much better! Thank you, Doctor! Woof woof!

bunny.description: An animated cartoon bunny character voice. Tiny, soft, very high and sweet, a little shy and gentle, speaks softly with small giggles. American accent. Studio-quality audio.
bunny.sample: Hi Doctor! I'm Clover! Hop hop! Hee hee! That tickles! I'm a little nervous… Ouch! That wasn't so bad! I feel all better! Thank you, Doctor! Bye bye!

bear.description: An animated cartoon bear cub character voice. Warm, low, slow and drowsy, cuddly and sleepy, with big yawns, gentle and friendly. American accent. Studio-quality audio.
bear.sample: Hi Doctor! I'm Bramble! Ahhhhh… yawn! Hee hee! That tickles! I'm so big! I was brave! I feel much better! Thank you, Doctor! Big bear hug!

kitty.description: An animated cartoon kitten character voice. High, sweet and playful with a little sass, purry and mischievous, giggly. American accent. Studio-quality audio.
kitty.sample: Hi Doctor! I'm Mochi! Meow! Hee hee! That tickles! Ooh, cold! Ouch! That wasn't so bad! I feel much better! Thank you, Doctor! Purrrr!

dino.description: An animated cartoon baby dinosaur character voice. Small but scrappy, gravelly and cute, a little raspy, brave and enthusiastic, loves to roar. American accent. Studio-quality audio.
dino.sample: Hi Doctor! I'm Pip! Rawr! Whoa! I'm so big! Ouch! That wasn't so bad! I was brave! I feel all better! Thank you, Doctor! Rawr!

elephant.description: An animated cartoon baby elephant character voice. Big, round and goofy, lower than you'd expect but still young-sounding, slow and gentle, friendly and a little clumsy. American accent. Studio-quality audio.
elephant.sample: Hi Doctor! I'm Peanut! Toot toot! Hee hee! That tickles! I'm a little nervous… Ouch! That wasn't so bad! I feel much better! Thank you, Doctor! Toot toot!
